instruction.text: Find the sentence that describes the character’s mood best.

atoms.sound: This picture shows Becky in her bedroom. She is very excited because today she is going on a trip to the beach. She has packed a bag full of delicious snacks and things to do at the beach. Luckily it is a lovely summer day and the sun is shining.

instruction.text: Find the sentence that describes Thomas’ character best.

atoms.sound: After driving to the beach, Becky ran out of the car and straight into the sea, which was freezing. While she was swimming, she made friends with a boy called Thomas. He was fun to play with and very generous too, he shared all his snacks with Becky.

instruction.text: Find the sentence that describes the setting best.

atoms.sound: When they got out of the sea, they looked around to find a spot to build a sandcastle. This was surprisingly difficult. The beach was very crowded, since it was such a sunny day. When they found a space, they built a huge sandcastle, complete with a moat and lots of shells to decorate the walls.

instruction.text: Find the sentence that describes the relationship between the characters best.

atoms.sound: They played for hours and were both very worn out. It was time to go home. Since meeting that morning, Becky and Thomas had become very good friends and promised to keep in touch with each other. On the way home, Becky told her mum all about her and Thomas’ amazing sandcastle.
